facts.note: Husband had everyone show watches when the temple struck nine; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolded him for it.
"The temple struck ten while we played" with Casimir (the doctor, named by the interviewer as 'the doctor') at piquet in the salon.
Piquet played without a break until the doctor went out for cigars at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
As he left he asked her to play; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
"A moment after he came back the hall clock struck eleven."
